prompt_text: Who is the best marketing agency in Maryland?
answer_verbatim:
“Best” depends on what you need. To recommend the best Maryland agency for you I need a few details. Quick questions:

- What type of marketing do you want? (digital ads, SEO, content, social, branding, B2B demand gen, PR, experiential, etc.)
- What industry are you in? (healthcare, fintech, education, e‑commerce, nonprofit…)
- Approximate annual/ monthly budget?
- Do you want a local MD agency (in-person) or is remote OK?
- Project length: one campaign, ongoing retainer, or full marketing outsourcing?
- Any must‑have capabilities (HubSpot, Salesforce, Google Ads, programmatic, video production)?

How I pick an agency for you
- Relevant case studies & measurable results (ROI, CAC, lead growth)
- Experience in your industry or with similar business models
- Clear reporting and KPIs
- Team skills match (strategy, creative, analytics)
- Pricing model and contract flexibility
- Client references and reviews

If you want to start researching now
- Use Clutch.co, UpCity, AgencySpotter and Google Reviews to find top-rated MD agencies
- Check local awards (Baltimore Business Journal, AAF Baltimore) and LinkedIn for client recommendations
- Ask for 2–3 case studies showing measurable outcomes and at least two references

If you give the details above, I’ll shortlist 4–6 Maryland agencies that fit your needs, with strengths, likely costs, and questions to ask each. Which details would you like to start with?
